name: Primitive Finite-Rotation Adjacency Pair Generator for ER Witness Search

source_objects.composition: C_a ·_rho C_b=C_c iff A(C_a,C_b,rho)=1; otherwise empty

source_result: Finite orientation re-embedding is capable of changing admissible adjacency at the primitive chirality-cell/substrate level; orientation is therefore a pair-generator for distinct adjacency states rather than a decorative label.
use_in_P022: Choose H0/H1 so their controlled difference contains a finite relative-orientation re-embedding from this admitted class. This makes a primitive adjacency difference source-grounded. Then test whether that difference is inherited into the selected ER-throat incidence / weighted-adjacency realization at Resolution R.
remaining_gap: Primitive rotation-generated adjacency must still be carried through the source-native persistence/Planck realization into the particular ER-throat incidence pair used by the hidden-S3/qualification witness. Matter-readout equality, physical embedding, action selection, and gravity separation remain open.
parent_status: QMO-AST-DM-050 remains open; primitive orientation-generated adjacency is not the same object as the parent HistorySupport-to-corridor-incidence witness.
